title: High-power hydrogel-based moisture-electric generators
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9457-9467
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04512F, Paper
Wenjun Ying, Zhoujun Huang, Zixiao Liu, Jinzhu Liu, Nanzhe Pan, Abdullatif Jazzar, Jie Zhang, Hua Zhang, Ximin He, Ruzhu Wang, Jiayun Wang
This work presents a high-power hydrogel-based moisture-electric generator via molecular engineering design, which achieves a superior open-circuit voltage of 0.6 V and a short-circuit current of 0.58 mA cm−2.
